fixes: KYC name-only updates preserve omitted phone, country and payout wallet with a presence-aware atomic SQL update
Profile editing requires a valid authoritative initial read and a typed persisted-write acknowledgement
Malformed HTTP 200 auth responses cannot confirm login, logout, verification or SMS operations
Reviewed registration cannot be bypassed through generic public sign-up proxy routes
Optional authenticated SMS consent is explicit, versioned, revocable and separate from marketing
SMS challenges are bound to account, phone and generation with persistent recipient/account cooldowns, bounded attempts and atomic consumption
SMS verification does not create sessions, tokens, historical identity bindings or tree nodes
Legacy Cognito phone controls and non-persistent 2FA/digest claims are removed from the Better Auth profile flow
Exact private SMS routes and scoped provider configuration preserve default-off and financial recovery gates
Generated local Cloudflare type files are not required for clean-checkout unit tests
